# Introduction

We will be using flights and weather datasets from nycflights13 package in R. This analysis will focus on data preparation, exploratory data analysis and statistical analysis to study departure delays for United Airlines flights originating from 3 New York City are airports. The analysis should address the relationship between departure dalays and following factors:
* Time of day
* Time of year
* Temperature
* Wind speed
* Precipitation
* Visibility


## Import Library and Data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(nycflights13)
```

```{r}
glimpse(flights)
```
```{r}
glimpse(weather)
```


# Data Cleansing
This step will focus on filtering data on carrier, since we are analyzing United Airlines flights only. We will also review and address missing or erroneous data. Finally, the dataset will be merged with weather dataset.

## Filter
Filter on United Airlines flights only (carrier: "UA")

```{r}
ua_flights <- flights %>%
  filter(carrier == "UA")
glimpse(ua_flights)
```

## Merge
Flights and weather datasets should be merged

```{r}
ua_flights_weather <- ua_flights %>%
  left_join(
    weather,
    by = c("origin", "year", "month", "day", "hour")
  )

glimpse(ua_flights_weather)
```
```{r}
ua_flights_weather %>%
  summarise(
    total_flights = n(),
    average_delay = mean(dep_delay, na.rm = TRUE),
    delay_sd = sd(dep_delay, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
```
The standard deviation of 35.72 suggests a large variation in departure delays.


## Handle missing/erroneous values

Take a look at missing values for our key data

```{r}

ua_flights_weather %>%
  summarise(
    total_flights = n(),
    missing_hour = sum(is.na(hour)),
    missing_month = sum(is.na(month)),
    missing_dep_delay = sum(is.na(dep_delay)),
    missing_temp = sum(is.na(temp)),
    missing_wind_speed = sum(is.na(wind_speed)),
    missing_precipitation = sum(is.na(precip)),
    missing_visibility = sum(is.na(visib))
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "Variable",
    values_to = "Count"
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Variable", "Count"),
    caption = "Summary of Missing Values in UA Flight Data"
  )


```

The merged dataset contains 58,665 United Airlines flight records. An examination of missing values indicates that the dataset is relatively complete. Departure delay has the most missing value with 686 observations missing. Missing values in weather related variables ranges from 304 to 321 observations. Overall, the low percentage of missing values suggests that most observations are available for analysis. However, additional examination is necessary to determine how missing observations should be handled before conducting exploratory analysis and permutation tests.

The above table provides information regarding missing observations per column.
Investigate how many rows are missing data and how many rows are complete. 

```{r}
ua_flights_weather %>%
  summarise(
    total_rows = n(),
    rows_with_missing = sum(
      !complete.cases( # Checks weather each row has missing values. In this case not operation captures rows with missing values.
        dep_delay, temp, wind_speed, precip, visib
      )
    ),
    complete_rows = sum(
      complete.cases(
        dep_delay, temp, wind_speed, precip, visib
      )
    )
  )
```

Out of 58,665 total flight records, 1,003 (1.71%) contain at least one missing value among the five variables examined: departure delay, temperature, wind speed, precipitation, and visibility. The remaining 57,662 records (98.29%) are complete for these variables. Overall, the dataset has a relatively low proportion of missing observations.


Remove rows with missing dependent variable (departure delay)

```{r}
ua_flights_weather <- ua_flights_weather %>%
  drop_na(dep_delay)
  
```

Check if all numerical predictors are missing from the dataset. Since we know the time of day and time of year is not missing any data, we can look at the missing variables from weather dataset. 

```{r}
ua_flights_weather %>%
  summarise(
    total_rows = n(),
    all_predictors_missing = sum(
      if_all(
        c(temp, wind_speed, precip, visib),
        is.na
      )
    )
  )
```
After excluding flights with missing departure delays, 57,979 observations remained. Of these, 293 (0.51%) had missing values for all four weather variables: temperature, wind speed, precipitation, and visibility. These missing values may indicate that corresponding weather observations were unavailable or that the weather measurements themselves were incomplete.


## Calculated columns
Create two calculated columns named late and very_late. 
* late <- departure delays greater than 0 minutes
* very_late <- departure delays greater than 30 minutes

```{r}
ua_flights_weather['late'] <- ua_flights_weather$dep_delay > 0
ua_flights_weather['very_late'] <- ua_flights_weather$dep_delay > 30

```
```{r}
glimpse(ua_flights_weather)
```

## Finalize dataset
Keep only variables relevant to the research questions.
```{r}

ua_final <- ua_flights_weather %>%
  select(
    year,
    month,
    day,
    hour,
    sched_dep_time,
    origin,
    carrier,
    flight,
    dep_delay,
    late,
    very_late,
    temp,
    wind_speed,
    precip,
    visib
  )

glimpse(ua_final)
```

Save clean dataset for analysis

```{r}
saveRDS(ua_final, "../data/ua_final.rds")
```
